title: Over 200 Indian Peacekeepers Receive UN Medal in South Sudan
summary: A total of 210 Indian peacekeepers received the United Nations Medal in Juba, South Sudan, on 17 August 2026. The award included six women and seven staff officers serving with the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS)....

blocks.content: A total of 210 Indian peacekeepers received the United Nations Medal in Juba, South Sudan, on 17 August 2026. The award included six women and seven staff officers serving with the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS).

items: The United Nations Medal is awarded to personnel serving in UN peacekeeping and related missions.
UNMISS stands for the United Nations Mission in South Sudan.
India has been a major troop contributor to UN peacekeeping since the early years of the UN system.
UNISFA is the United Nations Interim Security Force for Abyei, another UN mission in Africa.
